meta.title: Vendor Approval Levels (vendor.approval.levels) = 1 (minimum)
gaps: Set the tenant setting vendor.approval.levels to 1 and verify the value is accepted.
As a Buyer, invite a new supplier with primary details into the Prospect list.
Observe that the supplier requires exactly one sequential approval before activation and is activated after that approval.
Validate the Tenant Admin and Buyer persona permissions across this workflow.

args.need: as Tenant Admin set vendor.approval.levels to 1, then as Buyer invite a new supplier with primary details into the Prospect list and verify that exactly one sequential approval is required before the vendor is activated

steps.note: The catalog cannot change tenant settings, create vendor prospects, perform approval-level workflow actions, or switch between the required personas.
Final assertion that the observed workflow did not leave a visible application error or crash after the tester completed the missing steps.
